li.label: awful guest room
li.description: I paid for that? I have slept better in a ditch, and the ditch did not charge.

li.label: disappointing guest room
li.description: The room was below what I expected. Well below.

li.label: so-so guest room
li.description: The room was fine, if you squint.

li.label: decent guest room
li.description: A proper bed and a door that closes. That is all I ask.

li.label: good guest room
li.description: A lovely room. I slept well.

li.label: splendid guest room
li.description: A room like that makes the whole journey worth it.

li.label: awkward company
li.description: One of the hosts kept me company. We talked about the weather. At length.

li.label: good company
li.description: One of the hosts showed me around and kept me company.

li.label: charming company
li.description: The host was a delight. I may have laughed out loud.

li.label: wonderful company
li.description: I have not been looked after this well in years.

li.label: pestered to join
li.description: I came here to sleep, not to be recruited.

li.label: good talks
li.description: We have had some good conversations.
